rubric_intent: Score this research report on rigor and evidence.

dimensions.name: Methodological Soundness
dimensions.description: Evaluates the appropriateness and robustness of the research methods employed to answer the research question.
dimensions.evidence_instructions: Examine the 'Methods' or 'Methodology' section for details on study design, sampling, data collection techniques, and analytical procedures; assess if these align with the research question and are described with sufficient detail for replication.

dimensions.name: Data Quality and Integrity
dimensions.description: Assesses the reliability, validity, and ethical handling of the data used in the report.
dimensions.evidence_instructions: Look for descriptions of data sources, data cleaning procedures, measures taken to ensure data accuracy, and any discussion of potential biases or limitations in the data; check for ethical considerations in data collection and use.

dimensions.name: Evidence-Based Argumentation
dimensions.description: Measures how effectively the report uses evidence to support its claims and conclusions.
dimensions.evidence_instructions: Review the 'Results' and 'Discussion' sections to see if findings are directly linked to the data presented; check if interpretations are logical and well-supported by the evidence, and if counterarguments or alternative explanations are addressed.

dimensions.name: Literature Integration
dimensions.description: Examines the extent to which the report critically engages with and builds upon existing relevant literature.
dimensions.evidence_instructions: Analyze the 'Introduction' and 'Literature Review' sections for the breadth and depth of cited sources; assess if the report clearly positions its research within the existing scholarly conversation and identifies gaps or contributions.

dimensions.name: Clarity of Findings and Limitations
dimensions.description: Assesses the report's ability to clearly articulate its findings and acknowledge the limitations of the research.
dimensions.evidence_instructions: Examine the 'Results' and 'Discussion' sections for clear presentation of key findings; look for a dedicated section or integrated discussion of the study's limitations, potential biases, and areas for future research.

dimensions.name: Statistical Rigor (if applicable)
dimensions.description: Evaluates the appropriate and accurate application of statistical methods for data analysis.
dimensions.evidence_instructions: If statistical analysis is used, review the 'Methods' and 'Results' sections for the selection of appropriate statistical tests, correct application, and clear reporting of statistical significance and effect sizes; check for adherence to statistical reporting guidelines.
